verdict.RAN: Two fresh fits of one prespecified held-out fold of the highest original MLP: max_iter 300 and 3000, all other settings unchanged. Exit code 0.
verdict.PASSED: The 300-iteration fit exactly reproduced its stored OOF score. The 3000-iteration fit terminated without a ConvergenceWarning.
verdict.CORRECT: The original iteration cap actively truncates optimization on this fold. Increasing it improves the objective while only modestly changing this prediction. Normal optimizer termination here used relative objective reduction, not a small-gradient certificate.

decision.recommendation: Run a separately frozen descriptive sensitivity for all 18 MLP cells at max_iter=3000; preserve the original 72-probe results and original selected-probe permutation test unchanged.
decision.scientific_status: The original warning-limited estimator remains a reproducible preregistered exploratory algorithm, but its weak performance cannot establish absence of a nonlinear discriminator. The pilot supports a feasible optimization sensitivity, not a claim that all folds are stable or globally optimized.
decision.inference_boundary: Do not replace the original winner or attach its 72-test adjusted p-value to a supplemental winner. Selecting across the original 72 plus 18 supplemental fits expands the searched family to 90 configurations, and this extension is post-result.
decision.bounded_run: One supplemental pass at 3000 iterations with the existing max_fun=15000, seed, preprocessing, alpha, and optimizer; record each warning. No escalating optimization loop.
